name: crop-season-plan
description: Plan a cropping season for a small or family farm: what to grow on which field, the rotation, a dated calendar from land preparation to sale, input quantities and cost, expected yield and gross margin, and the risks with a fallback for each. Use when asked to plan my season, what should I plant this year, make a crop calendar, work out seed and fertiliser needs, or is this crop worth growing. Produces a field-by-field plan, a season calendar, an input and cash budget, a gross margin estimate per crop, and a risk table.
